discovery_calculation.missing_policy: for discovery-only interval median slope, use all finite replicate slopes and require >=2; no missing PFU is imputed
discovery_calculation.observed_release_signature: population free-PFU trajectory declines through early adsorption-like phase, then shows sustained positive median log-slope; strong release-like transition lies in 5.0-5.5 h region
discovery_calculation.release_weight: positive median log-slope multiplied by interval duration, starting at first nonnegative interval in the sustained release segment and ending at the first subsequent nonpositive median-slope interval
discovery_calculation.quantile_map: cumulative release_weight / total release_weight; predicted quantile time is right endpoint of first interval crossing target quantile

truth_extraction.parse: headerless numeric rows from SingleCellInfections.csv with exactly five columns
truth_extraction.per_time_fraction: sum(lysed)/sum(infected) pooled over replicate IDs at identical sample_time, finite rows only, denominator>0
truth_extraction.missing: UNRESOLVED if either threshold is not reached

primary_gate.near_hit: if exact_hit fails, BOTH predictions must be within one median single-cell sampling interval; near_hit is recorded but cannot be promoted to BLIND_EXACT_PASS
primary_gate.failure: either prediction farther than one median sampling interval

combinatorial_null.candidate_space: all ordered pairs (a,b) drawn from observed unique single-cell sample times with a<=b
combinatorial_null.p: fraction of candidate pairs with distance <= distance of frozen pair (5.5,6.0)

mirror_control.construction: reverse the exposed population log-PFU values over the original ascending time grid, retain missingness as reversed values, calculate finite median interval slopes, and apply the same sustained-positive release-weight quantile map
mirror_control.requirement: the reverse-derived quantile pair must have strictly larger combinatorial distance to observed (t10,t50) than the frozen native pair

promotion.C038_WEAK_PASS: near_hit but not exact/rare; cannot support novelty
next_on_strong_pass: dedicated prior-art killer sweep for model-free population-trajectory prediction of empirical single-cell lysis quantiles
freeze unchanged transport to a second independently authored lytic phage/virus dataset
